=== Home media ===
The film began streaming on Amazon Prime Video from 6 March 2026.
The film was released for streaming on ZEE5 on 15 May 2026.

=== OTT release ===
The worldwide streaming rights for the film were acquired by Sony Pictures Networks India and it was released exclusively on Sony LIV on 10 April 2026.
It was released on 10 July 2026 on ZEE5 and received a positive response from critics and audiences, particularly for its subject, direction, and performances.
The film premiered on Zee5 on 11 September 2026.
